oracleRisk.summary: mF-ONE mints and redeems at a Midas-administered net asset value rather than an independent market price. Midas documents that the strategy manager supplies the NAV, that Midas validates it internally with at least two trained co-signers and deviation bounds, and that the approved value is pushed onchain to the Oracle Feed consumed by the minter and redeemer; payment tokens are priced by Chainlink and Pyth inside a 0.997-1.003 stablecoin band. Pricing authority is therefore issuer and strategy-manager administered NAV. No mF-ONE Oracle Feed address, heartbeat or threshold was read onchain this run, so no redundancy, failover or independently verified publisher set is credited.

branchApplicability.rationale: mF-ONE is a tokenized certificate over the Fasanara F-ONE private-credit and digital-asset strategy: holders open no debt position and the issuer documents no borrower collateral, liquidation engine or liquidatable branch. The administered NAV prices issuance and redemption at the token level only.
